tex_content.html: \begin{exercise} \end{exercise}[The Gauss--Bonnet theorem for surfaces with boundary] 1. ch9:9-10↗ thm:gauss-bonnet-formula ↗ thm:gauss-bonnet-theorem Suppose $(M, g)$ is a compact Riemannian 2-manifold with boundary, endowed with a smooth triangulation such that the intersection of each curved triangle with $\partial M$, if not empty, is either a single vertex or a single edge. Then \[ \int _M K \, dA + \int _{\partial M} \kappa _N \, ds = 2\pi \chi (M), \] where $\kappa _N$ is the signed geodesic curvature of $\partial M$ with respect to the inward-pointing normal $N$. \end{exercise}
